en: Alright, Pooichi! You ready?
Ready?

Huh? Don't look at me like I just blew up a dove
with a rocket launcher!

I, Miu Iruma, the gorgeous girl genius, am
gonna devote my time to you!

And you'll entertain me in return, right?
You'll leave me 100% satisfied, right?
I-I don't know about that...

Huhhhh!? Are you sayin' you invited me
without makin' any plans?

Typical... When men see the heat I'm packin',
they get all nervous and stiff.

But since you caught me in a good mood...
Alright, I'll show you my inventions!
Follow me!

<CLT=cltMIND>Without waiting for my answer,
Miu strutted toward her lab.

Ta-da! Here we are—Miu Iruma's research
lab!
<CLT=cltMIND>I know that, you brought me here...
Now, the first invention I'll show ya is this!
What is this? A sensor?

Wow, you actually figured out it's a sensor!
But can you guess what kinda sensor!?
I don't know.

That's what I thought!
I call this baby the "Hookup Counter"!
Hookup Counter?

It counts how many people you've fucked!
Or how many have fucked you!
D-Don't point that at me!
Too late! Let's see the result, shall we?

HAH-HAHAHAHA!
No fuckin' way! You kiddin' me!?
<CLT=cltMIND>What did it say? What did it say!?
Now, on to the next invention!

<CLT=cltMIND>Miu held out a machine that looked
like an arm with a boxing glove on the fist.
...What is this?

"Auto-Puncher that Punches You for Telling
Terrible Dirty Jokes"!
Why is the name so literal!?

Who cares? Sometimes I'm too lazy to think
of names.

I'm constantly crankin' out new inventions!
You can't expect me to name 'em all!

I mean, do you name each of your little dudes
after you blast 'em into a tissue?
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>*BAM!*
Grgh!
Ah!

<CLT=cltMIND>Miu got punched pretty hard...
Is she okay?

Sh-Sheesh... That was sudden...
Still, though...that was a good punch...
<CLT=cltMIND>I guess she's fine.

Hehehehehe... Alright, sorry to cut your fun
short, but I got one more invention to show!
What is it this time?

<CLT=cltMIND>This looks like...a ray gun from
a science fiction movie.

This baby'll teleport underwear in a flash!
I call it the "Goin' Commando" gun!
What?

Just point this light at a pair of underwear,
and you can send it anywhere you want!
Whaddaya think!? Cool shit, right!?
What? You can teleport objects!?
Not all objects! Just underwear!

<CLT=cltMIND>Just underwear? She's wasting this
incredible technology on underwear?

Hah-hahahaha! Whaddaya think!?
Bow before my formidable talent!

*sigh*...I don't know what to say.
This is all very odd.

Wh-What...? D-Don't...look at me like that...
With those...cold eyes...
I just...wanted to show this stuff to you...
<CLT=cltMIND>Uh oh, did I upset her?

No, um, it's...really creative!
Really good stuff.
Really?

Yeah! I think it's good that...you have
so much fun with your inventions.

Ya think so? That makes me happy.
Yeah, my inventions are...

Hah-hahahahaha! My inventions are always
awesome, without even sayin' it!

But even geniuses like to be praised! You seem
to understand that pretty well!

Y'know, you're pretty alright!
I'll treat you real good from now on!

Just make sure my technique doesn't blow
your mind too hard!
Hah-hahahahahahahaha!

<CLT=cltMIND>You'll treat me "good"?
So you're not gonna...test anything on me, right?

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Miu's <CLT=cltSTRONG>Report Card<CLT=cltSYSTEM> has been updated
based on your experience with her.

<CLT=cltMIND>My brain feeling a bit scrambled,
I returned to my room.
